title: Secure steward adoption + >=1 documented citation/use
context: Per the Elyos 'delivered, not merged' bar, the project is not shipped until a qualified steward has adopted or cited the corpus. A qualifying steward is a named, non-profit or public-interest organization that (1) publicly hosts or links the corpus, (2) commits to cite it in at least one finding aid, lesson, exhibit, research output, or catalog, and (3) names a contact who confirms the data met a real need. This task closes the delivery loop: the corpus is in a beneficiary's hands, the project is shipped.
objective: Secure a formal commitment from at least one qualifying steward organization (non-profit or public-interest; publicly hosts or links the corpus; commits to at least one documented citation or downstream use; names a confirming contact) and document at least one concrete citation or use of the corpus in the steward's output.
acceptanceCriteria: A named, qualifying steward organization has committed in writing (email, MOU, public announcement, or equivalent) to adopt and/or publicly host or link the corpus.
Steward commits to cite the corpus in at least one output (finding aid, lesson plan, exhibit, research paper, catalog entry, or equivalent).
A named contact at the steward confirms the corpus met a real need for their organization or its users.
At least one concrete citation or downstream use of the corpus is documented (URL, publication reference, or equivalent).
Steward commitment and citation documented in docs/partner-outreach-log.md and a new docs/steward-commitment.md file committed via PR.
verifiedNeed flag update documented: once this task delivers, the project maintainer may update verifiedNeed to true on delivery-dependent tasks.
output: docs/steward-commitment.md — steward commitment letter or summary, contact confirmation, and documented citation/use, plus updated docs/partner-outreach-log.md, committed via PR.
